title: Bellevue Home Energy Rebates 2026: Puget Sound Energy Heat Pump, Water Heater, Windows
desc: Bellevue home energy rebates for 2026: Puget Sound Energy pays $1,500 for a heat pump, $1,000 for a water heater, insulation and window rebates, and $2,400 to $4,000 for income-qualified homes.
badge: $1,500 heat pump, $1,000 water heater, more by income
lead: Many Bellevue homes get electricity or gas from Puget Sound Energy, which pays rebates for heat pumps, water heaters, insulation, windows and thermostats. About half of its customers can also qualify for higher amounts based on income.
cards_heading: Bellevue home energy rebates at a glance
cards_intro: We read Puget Sound Energy's rebate pages and the State Department of Commerce page on October 6, 2026. These rebates are for existing single-family homes and depend on whether PSE supplies your electricity, your natural gas or both. Check your bill, since gas and electric offers differ.

cards.title: Heat pump
cards.note: Replacing electric resistance heat, adding a hybrid heat pump to a gas furnace or replacing an old ducted heat pump. $2,400 by income. Income-qualified gas customers switching to a heat pump get $4,000.

cards.title: Heat pump water heater
cards.note: $1,100 for income-qualified households. Installed on or after January 1, 2026.

cards.title: Insulation and air sealing
cards.note: Attic insulation $1.75 per square foot up to $3,500 for the thinnest attics. Walls and floors $2.50 per square foot up to $5,000 each.

cards.title: Windows
cards.note: $200 per window by income. Buy and install by December 31, 2026.

cards.title: Smart thermostat
cards.note: $175 or $130 by income. Buy and install by December 31, 2026.

cards.title: Efficiency Boost
cards.note: Check your household size, income and county on PSE's form. About half of PSE customers qualify.

after_cards:
Lower-income help

The state lists King County and Energy Smart Eastside as local partners for its home electrification rebates for households at or below 150 percent of area median income. King County received $3,775,416 and Energy Smart Eastside $500,000. The state page gives no dollar amount per household, so ask the partner. The federal clean energy credits ended after 2025.
sections:
The US Census Bureau's American Community Survey (2020 to 2024) counts 66,021 homes in Bellevue. About 52 percent of households own and 48 percent rent. About 46 percent of homes are detached houses and about 5 percent sit in buildings of two to four units. About 47 percent were built before 1980, almost none before 1940, and about 27 percent in 2000 or later.

For main heating fuel, about 52 percent of homes use electricity and about 46 percent use utility gas. That near-even split makes the choice between PSE's electric and gas rebates a real one for many Bellevue households.
Electric or gas, check your bill

PSE sorts its heat pump rebates by what heats your home now. Electric resistance heat gets the $1,500 rebate. A gas furnace can get the $1,500 hybrid rebate if the furnace stays as a backup. An income-qualified gas household that leaves gas behind can get $4,000. The rules are about your PSE accounts, so look at which PSE bills you get. Our Puget Sound Energy guide has every rule.

PSE says you must use a PSE Recommended Energy Professional or Trade Ally and you may not use an out-of-network contractor or do the work yourself. Ask each bidder to confirm in writing that they are in PSE's network. That matters, because a rebate from a contractor who is not in the network can be denied.
claim_steps: Check whether PSE sends your electric bill, your gas bill or both.
Check Efficiency Boost on PSE's income form to see which amounts apply.
Pick a PSE Recommended Energy Professional or Trade Ally.
Ask each bidder to list every rebate as a line on the bid.
Call a PSE Energy Advisor at 1-800-562-1482 if a rule does not fit.
faq: What rebates does Puget Sound Energy offer in Bellevue?
On our October 6, 2026 reading: $1,500 for a heat pump, $1,000 for a heat pump water heater, insulation and window rebates, a $75 thermostat rebate and higher amounts by income.
Is Bellevue served by Puget Sound Energy?
Check your bill. If PSE sends your electric or gas bill, these rebates apply.
Do I need a PSE contractor?
Yes for the main rebates. PSE says to use a Recommended Energy Professional or Trade Ally.
We did not read a PSE solar rebate. Washington exempts solar equipment and installation from sales tax through 2029, and PSE pays up to $1,000 for enrolling a battery in its Flex program.
No. The IRS says it ended after 2025.
